response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to event-driven systems and AI-agent tooling, but lacks demonstrable production-scale experience with multi-agent AI in regulated fintech environments, team leadership beyond individual contributor roles, and explicit depth in real-time credit risk or working-capital systems required for this executive role.
strengths: Proven experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems across multiple domains.
Hands-on contribution to AI-agent infrastructure and tooling (e.g., MCP code generators) at re:cinq.
Strong open-source portfolio and technical communication skills demonstrated through workshops and projects.
concerns: No clear evidence of leading engineering teams from 10+ to 30+ people or developing senior technical leadership layers.
Lacks documented production experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulated financial AI systems.
No indication of experience designing model-agnostic agentic frameworks with observability, feedback loops, or compliance infrastructure.
